title: Which floor is the lift attendant on after an hour?
description: A lift attendant keeps a positive token for every plus press and a negative token for every minus press. Pairs of one positive and one negative token cancel, and the tokens left show his floor. Keeko doubts this and counts all eight tokens as the floor.
teaching_notes: One idea: a positive token and a negative token cancel to zero, and the tokens left give the floor. Watch for students who count every token and ignore whether it is positive or negative.

source: He starts on the ground floor (Floor 0) with an empty pocket. After one hour, he checks his pocket and finds 5 positive and 3 negative tokens. On which floor is he now?
video_script.why: The child reads a set of positive and negative tokens as a floor number by cancelling zero pairs.
video_script.substitution: Match each negative token with a positive token, take away the zero pairs, and read the floor from the tokens left.
video_script.anchor: the lift attendant's pocket of positive and negative tokens
video_script.wrong_move: counts every token in the pocket and calls that number the floor
video_script.payoff_line: Positive five plus negative three leaves positive two.

names.Ruhee: the multi-storey building with floors above and below the ground, where the lift attendant works

maths_rules: each plus press puts 1 positive token (+1) in the pocket; each minus press puts 1 negative token (−1)
1 positive and 1 negative token make a zero pair: (+1) + (−1) = 0
3 negative tokens match 3 positive tokens, giving 3 zero pairs; 5 − 3 = 2 positive tokens stay
slip: 5 + 3 = 8 counts the tokens, but positive and negative tokens pull in opposite directions
video_script.design: One idea: cancel zero pairs and read the floor from the tokens left. The pocket of tokens stays on screen for the whole video; positive tokens are green and negative tokens are red as in the book. Keeko's doubt is that the number of tokens is the floor.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book, about the lift attendant in Ruhee.
<bookmark mark='pocket'/>He starts on the ground floor with an empty pocket.
<bookmark mark='press'/>Each plus press puts a positive token in his pocket. Each minus press puts a negative token there.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>After one hour, his pocket holds five positive and three negative tokens. On which floor is he now?

beats.on_screen: the pocket of tokens and the question stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: one green token and one red token joined by a ring labelled zero pair

marks.name: a ring closes round the two tokens and the words zero pair appear

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='pair'/>A positive token and a negative token cancel each other, because together they are worth zero.
<bookmark mark='name'/>We call such a pair of tokens a zero pair.
Taking away a zero pair does not change what the pocket is worth.

beats.on_screen: Given: start Floor 0; 5 positive tokens and 3 negative tokens, (+5) + (−3)

marks.given: the start floor and the two token counts are written, with the sum (+5) + (−3)

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the pocket holds five positive tokens and three negative tokens, which is positive five plus negative three.

beats.on_screen: To find: the floor where the attendant is now

marks.find: the words the floor are written and underlined

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the floor where the attendant is now.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: match each negative token with a positive token; 3 zero pairs are ringed

marks.match: each of the 3 red tokens joins a green token and a ring closes round each pair
marks.count: the number of zero pairs is written next to the rings

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='match'/>Step one, match each negative token with a positive token, because each pair is a zero pair.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Three negative tokens give three zero pairs.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: take away the 3 zero pairs; 2 green positive tokens stay in the pocket

marks.remove: the 3 ringed pairs fade out of the pocket
marks.left: 2 green tokens stay in the pocket

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='remove'/>Step two, take away the three zero pairs, because each pair is worth zero.
<bookmark mark='left'/>Two positive tokens stay in the pocket.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Positive five plus negative three leaves positive two.
<bookmark mark='floor'/>The lift attendant is on floor positive two.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the pocket of tokens
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble says floor 8 and is struck through; the tokens show 3 pairs cancelling

marks.doubt: Keeko's bubble shows the number of tokens, 8, as the floor
marks.pull: positive tokens and negative tokens pull the lift in opposite directions
marks.fix: the bubble is struck through and only the tokens left are lit

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the attendant is on floor eight, because the pocket holds eight tokens.
<bookmark mark='pull'/>But positive tokens and negative tokens pull in opposite directions.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Three pairs cancel, so only the tokens left decide the floor.
